function:scripts/ingest.mjs:slugify.name: slugify
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:slugify.summary: Converts arbitrary labels into stable lowercase underscore-separated identifiers.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:cleanLine.name: cleanLine
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:cleanLine.summary: Removes citation markers, bullet prefixes, and excess whitespace from imported report lines.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:isNoiseLine.name: isNoiseLine
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:isNoiseLine.summary: Recognizes navigation, timestamp, URL, and interaction-checker boilerplate that should be excluded from report parsing.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:normalizeDru.name: normalizeDrugName
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:normalizeDru.summary: Canonicalizes drug names by removing product qualifiers and normalizing punctuation and whitespace.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:getOrCreateD.name: getOrCreateDrug
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:getOrCreateD.summary: Resolves a normalized drug identity in the ingestion map or creates a pending identity while preserving useful aliases.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:addDoseSugge.name: addDoseSuggestions
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:addDoseSugge.summary: Merges cleaned, unique dose suggestions into a drug record with a bounded result size.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:extractDoseS.name: extractDoseSuggestions
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:extractDoseS.summary: Extracts plausible dosing statements from report text using units, dosage-form, route, and frequency heuristics.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:readTextFile.name: readTextFiles
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:readTextFile.summary: Recursively discovers supported source text files while recording paths skipped by extension filtering.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:parseDrugHea.name: parseDrugHeader
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:parseDrugHea.summary: Infers the primary drug name and aliases from cleaned report headings and the source filename.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:collectInter.name: collectInteractionSections
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:collectInter.summary: Collects report text under recognized severity headings while stopping at unrelated clinical sections.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:splitBlocks.name: splitBlocks
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:splitBlocks.summary: Segments interaction-section lines into logical records using blanks, bullets, headings, and continuation rules.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:looksLikeDru.name: looksLikeDrugHeading
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:looksLikeDru.summary: Classifies short report lines that resemble drug-name headings rather than narrative content.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:parseBulletR.name: parseBulletRecord
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:parseBulletR.summary: Parses a structured bullet block into interacting-drug and narrative fields when its syntax is sufficiently complete.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:inferMechani.name: inferMechanism
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:inferMechani.summary: Infers a concise pharmacologic interaction mechanism from characteristic phrases in source evidence.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:inferRecomme.name: inferRecommendation
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:inferRecomme.summary: Derives a clinical handling recommendation from interaction severity and narrative cues.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:inferMonitor.name: inferMonitoring
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:inferMonitor.summary: Builds monitoring guidance from evidence mentioning ECG, bleeding, laboratory, sedation, or vital-sign risks.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:createIntera.name: createInteraction
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:createIntera.summary: Constructs a normalized interaction record with evidence provenance, review state, and knowledge-base version metadata.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:parseReport.name: parseReport
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:parseReport.summary: Orchestrates complete report parsing by resolving drugs, extracting severity sections and dose hints, and emitting interaction and report records.

function:scripts/ingest.mjs:buildKnowled.name: buildKnowledgeBase
function:scripts/ingest.mjs:buildKnowled.summary: Reads all source reports, merges drug and interaction records, deduplicates pairs, and assembles the versioned active knowledge-base document.
